name: Savage Maceball
description: Swing from a settled two-finger grip so the head arrives square on the target's shoulder.

name: Crushswat
description: Hinge at the shoulder and let the head fall straight onto an opponent's raised forearm.

name: Ironknob Hasp
description: Present the flange face to an incoming edge and turn it off with a short wrist twist.

name: Lithe Flangerib
description: Slide the lead foot a hand's width past the opponent's front foot to take the inside line.

name: Ruthless Pearhead
description: Pack qi into the haft and bring the head down hard enough to split a wooden shield board.

name: Pearthwack
description: Link two qi-fed swings, high then low, so the opponent cannot answer either without exposing the other.

name: Acrid Ribhead
description: Rise in the stirrups and bring the head down over a mount's neck onto a rider's shoulder.

name: Rushing Batter
description: Swing across the saddle's front while the reins pull the mount into the turn behind the blow.

name: Maceneck Hasp
description: Hold the haft upright beside the mount's neck and knock aside a lance or sword thrust.

name: Crushcurl
description: Advance on foot beneath a rider's mace arm so the swing passes high over the head.

name: Entangling Smash
description: Hook the knob behind a rider's belt or cloak and haul with qi to drag them off balance.

name: Wild Studhead
description: Swing low from the ground to catch a rider's knee against the saddle, crushing it with qi-weighted force.

name: Rooted Haftring
description: Stand in the stirrups with qi through the legs and haft to take a charging blow without falling.

name: Brisk Wristloop
description: Strike the same point on a shield rim repeatedly until the arm behind it tires and drops.

name: Batterflog
description: Knock the head into the shield's central boss to shove the shield back into its bearer's chest.

name: Ribhasp
description: Hook the flange over a shield's upper edge and pull it down to open the face.

name: Rugged Crush
description: Swing over a raised shield and drop the head onto the helm behind it.

name: Prowling Dent
description: Circle wide of a shield's open side so the mace's reach clears the shield to the flank.

name: Poundbuckle
description: Strike a shield wall's lead man on the shield low edge to break the line of the shoulders.

name: Studhead Hammerfall
description: Drive qi through the head into a shield's centre so the shock passes through to the arm behind.

name: Rushing Haftring
description: Rattle blow after blow on a shield's rim, giving the bearer no pause to raise a weapon.

name: Hungry Pulp
description: Turn a flange edge into the target so it bites cloth and padding before the head lands.

name: Bellhead Swat
description: Draw the flange edge across the target's thigh in a raking slice to open the leg's muscle.

name: Rigid Maceneck
description: Slide the opponent's blade along the haft into the flange and push it out of line.

name: Veering Crush
description: Step round the flange's swing arc in a short pivot so the head returns without a wasted motion.

name: Crushhasp
description: Let the flange catch a sleeve or belt, then pull with qi to drag the opponent off their feet.

name: Keen Dent
description: Bring the flanged crown down on a helmet's ridge, sending qi through the metal into the skull.

name: Bold Batter
description: Swing on a counted beat and let the head's own weight pull it round to the next target.

name: Rushing Pearhead
description: Strike upward, let the head fall back, and ride its weight into a down-swing.

name: Shielding Bellhead
description: Hold the haft in guard for a count of two while qi settles, then release it into a strike.

name: Macestalk
description: Step in on the half-beat just after an opponent's swing ends, while their guard is open.

name: Ribhead Slap
description: Let the head swing on its haft like a pendulum and catch it at the end of each arc.

name: Pulp Carapace
description: Check the opponent's swing with the haft as your own weight shifts, spoiling their rhythm.

name: Poundswat
description: Let the head fall repeatedly onto the same guard, building a drumming beat the opponent cannot break.

name: Batterswat
description: Strike a brigandine coat at its metal studs so the rivets bend and bite into the wearer.

name: Savage Pound
description: Knock the head on the edge of a greave to numb the shin and unsettle the stance.

name: Wild Ironknob
description: Tap the face guard of a helm near the visor slit to blur the wearer's sight.

name: Burdening Maceball
description: Hook the flange behind an arm plate and pull so the plate's joint strains.

name: Pulpswerve
description: Close to an armored opponent's inside where long swings are weak and the mace's head still lands.

name: Smashscreen
description: Press the knob under a gorget's rim and lever up so the neck guard rides high and opens.

name: Brisk Flangerib
description: Drive qi through the head into a plate seam so the metal bends and crushes the flesh beneath.

name: Ribslap
description: Land a qi-heavy blow on the breastplate's side so the shock rattles the ribs inside.

name: Fierce Bellhead
description: Strike an armored elbow or knee joint with qi-packed weight so the joint's plate jams and fails.

name: Rugged Wristloop
description: Choke up on the haft and swing the head in a short, hard arc inside the opponent's reach.

name: Ruthless Wristloop
description: Drive the pommel into the sternum from a chest-to-chest clinch to shove the opponent back.

name: Crushprop
description: Lay the haft across an opponent's elbow and lever it against their own body.

name: Ducking Pulp
description: Slip a half-step sideways in a clinch so the mace head clears and the opponent's body is exposed.

name: Rude Pound
description: Punch the knob into the opponent's lower ribs while their arms are trapped by the clinch.

name: Macebuckle
description: Hook the head over a shoulder and pull with the haft to turn the opponent's back toward you.

name: Tethering Ribhead
description: Twist the haft across an opponent's arm with qi in the wrists to throw them across your hip.

name: Ribbuckle
description: Push the haft against the opponent's chest with qi behind it and drive them back several paces.

name: Flangerib Barrier
description: Slam the haft's side against an inside thrust, using qi to knock the weapon wide and clear.

name: Smash Swat
description: Run qi down the haft into the head just before impact so the blow lands with added weight.

name: Sturdy Maceball
description: Let qi hum along the haft as it meets a blade and turn the edge off the line.

name: Pulpstalk
description: Circle the mace once in a low arc while qi settles through the legs for the next move.

name: Gripping Maceneck
description: Strike the haft against the opponent's weapon to ring qi through it and make their grip falter.

name: Ruthless Ironknob
description: Thrust the knob with a pulse of qi so the blow reaches deeper than muscle alone could drive.

name: Pearscorer
description: Surge qi to the head at the end of a long reach to land a hard blow beyond the expected range.

name: Ribthwack
description: Extend the arm fully on the swing so the head just reaches the opponent's guard hand.

name: Stalwart Haftring
description: Retreat a step while holding the haft up so a thrust meets wood instead of the body.

name: Lassoing Batter
description: Hold the full reach with the head low so an opponent cannot close without crossing its arc.

name: Coasting Dent
description: Switch between choked and full grip as you step so the reach changes unexpectedly.

name: Lurching Pound
description: Drop the rear foot back and bring the head down in a lunging arc from an unexpected distance.

name: Scudding Smash
description: Rush forward behind the head with qi in the legs, closing a full spear's length in one burst.

name: Stubborn Pearhead
description: Hold the haft out at arm's length with qi through the grip to stop a closing opponent short.

name: Maceflog
description: Open with a plain swing that sets up the following links of the drill.

name: Macethwack
description: Lead the backswing from the hip so the head returns with more speed than the arm alone gives.

name: Layered Studhead
description: Rotate the haft after a parry so the flange comes round for an immediate strike.

name: Pirouetting Maceball
description: Step into the chain with the foot opposite the swing so the body stays square.

name: Tethering Crush
description: Check an opponent's counter with the knob at the end of a chain and reset the grip.

name: Poundslap
description: Strike high, middle and low in a descending ladder so one blow always finds an open line.

name: Haftring Flog
description: Link five swings with qi carried from one into the next so each lands heavier than the last.

name: Studhead Buckle
description: Circle the haft through a full guard circuit that turns away three attacks from different angles.
